name: Hubble USDH
oneLiner: USDH is Hubble Protocol's decentralized Solana stablecoin backed by overcollateralized CDP vaults and USDC held through its Peg Stability Module.
collateral: 94.4468% USDC deposited through the Peg Stability Module and 5.5532% Hubble CDP-backed issuance at the latest pinned read; the CDP collateral-asset weights remain incomplete
pegMechanism: Borrowers mint USDH against overcollateralized Solana vaults, while the Peg Stability Module supports zero-slippage USDH/USDC conversion and holds deposited USDC as direct backing

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hubble's official documentation identifies the January 2022 launch and describes USDH issuance through collateralized borrowing positions, the USDH liquidation vault, and peg-stability operations, supporting the CDP classification and launch month.

The borrowing IDL rejects invalid Scope parses (ParseScopePriceAccountFailed), invalid prices (PriceNotValid), and spot prices too divergent from TWAP (PriceTooDivergentFromTwap). No independent secondary oracle failover path is configured; Scope's published default_max_age for this feed is 160 (config units are max_age_slot-style; no second-denominated heartbeat is asserted here).

branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless tryLiquidate (and tryLiquidateCashBased) consume scopePrices and, for the original DeFi Treasury vault path, settle debt by burning USDH from the Stability Vault while seizing collateral at about a 10% discount for vault depositors. Liquidation is immediate once the position breaches the vault maximum LTV; no grace delay is documented.
branches.backstop: USDH Stability Vault (Stability Pool) is the first-loss liquidator for original-vault assets: deposited USDH is burned to cover liquidated debt and forfeited collateral is distributed to vault providers.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: If the Stability Vault is empty, debt and collateral of liquidated positions are redistributed pro-rata across remaining borrowers. If a position is already undercollateralized (bad debt), redistribution bypasses the Stability Vault even when it still holds USDH. GlobalConfig exposes emergencyMode and per-action block flags (including blockTryLiquidate) but no separate automatic global settlement module was identified in the reviewed sources.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Liquidations still go through the Hubble program tryLiquidate path with scopePrices, but hybrid docs assign newly onboarded assets and vaults to market-based bot liquidations that purchase collateral at a vault-LTV-dependent discount rather than relying solely on Stability Vault USDH burn.
branches.backstop: Hybrid model: market liquidators are the primary settlers for newly onboarded vaults; USDH Vault stakers may still receive a residual share of seized collateral without burning their USDH. Protocol-wide redistribution remains the residual backstop when liquidations cannot clear debt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Same redistribution rules as the DeFi Treasury path: empty Stability Vault or undercollateralized bad debt socializes remaining debt and collateral across active borrowers. No separate market2-only settlement module was identified.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 at finalized Solana slot 437979676. The tracked USDH mint retains freezeAuthority = null, so no direct Solana token-account freeze path exists. Circle can freeze that reserve asset and impair the dominant USDH exit path, so USDH resolves Upstream rather than No.

reserveReview.rationale: A finalized Solana read through Hubble's official SDK at slot 434386680 returned 1,069,376.821209 USDC both deposited and minted through the PSM, plus 62,876.204453 USDH borrowed across the three configured borrowing markets. Those issuance-path liabilities reconcile to circulating supply within 0.0041% and normalize to 94.4468% PSM USDC and 5.5532% CDP-backed USDH. The 2026-08-08 R13 pass split the sub-material CDP branch using active depositedCollateral from borrowing-market states at Solana slot 438037097 priced through the Scope Hubble feed (with CoinGecko spots for SRM, FTT and LDO placeholder prices). The resulting weights are mSOL 56.41%, SOL 20.95%, kUSDH-USDC Orca kToken 13.06%, daoSOL 4.08%, BTC 4.05%, and a grouped 'other' slice 1.46% (STSOL, ETH, cSOL, RAY, LDO, FTT).

notices.title: Small float, dormant trading
notices.message: Hubble's USDH circulating supply has contracted to roughly $1.2–1.5M with very low secondary-market volume. The Hubble team's focus has shifted to sister protocol Kamino, though no formal USDH wind-down has been announced and the borrow app remains operational.

mintAuthority.summary: USDH mint authority is a PDA of the Hubble Protocol program. The live program remains upgradeable through Hubble DAO SPL Governance: three of seven current council votes can meet the 40% approval threshold, early vote tipping is enabled, and the instruction hold-up is zero.

controls.label: Hubble borrowing-market program (USDH mint authority PDA)
controls.capDescription: Current program logic bounds minting by overcollateralized CDP vaults at a 150% minimum collateral ratio against whitelisted Solana assets; Hubble DAO governance can replace that program logic.
controls.evidence: USDH mint USDH1SM1ojwWUga67PGrgFWUHibbjqMvuMaDkRJTgkX returned mintAuthority AkzcmXAWWmGnVmyEfW5eeaHdUUrE9yxGaS2GmtV5UEMq and freezeAuthority None. A fee-drip transaction at slot 425776110 shows Hubble program HubbLeXBb7qyLHt3x7gvYaRrxQmmgExb7fCJgDqFuB6T invoking SPL Token MintTo with that PDA. The program is not immutable: its ProgramData names live upgrade authority vX3gFkePCptwTmJAcMypCq9trzrtarVf9PmT3AEke1v.

controls.label: Hubble program upgrade governance
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432742753, Hubble ProgramData DDkP2VqXhiAnWVJWBR29tfCkztttQaFccv4iYTS6sfQJ named this SPL Governance account as upgrade authority. The account governs HubbLeXBb7qyLHt3x7gvYaRrxQmmgExb7fCJgDqFuB6T in the Hubble DAO realm. Its council configuration had a 40% yes-vote threshold, minimum one council token to create a proposal, 259200-second base voting time, early vote tipping, and zero instruction hold-up. Seven active council token-owner records each held one deposited vote, so three affirmative votes can meet the threshold and no guaranteed post-approval execution delay applies.

review.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432742753, USDH mint authority AkzcmXAWWmGnVmyEfW5eeaHdUUrE9yxGaS2GmtV5UEMq remained the Hubble program PDA and the mint had no freeze authority. Contrary to the prior immutability claim, ProgramData DDkP2VqXhiAnWVJWBR29tfCkztttQaFccv4iYTS6sfQJ encoded live upgrade authority vX3gFkePCptwTmJAcMypCq9trzrtarVf9PmT3AEke1v. That address decoded as the Hubble DAO SPL Governance account for the program. Seven active council records held one vote each; the 40% threshold requires three votes, while early tipping and zero instruction hold-up provide no guaranteed execution delay after approval.
